steps.en: Install and start it — the desktop release, or the CLI install script
steps.zh: 装上并启动：桌面版安装包，或 CLI 安装脚本

steps.en: Starts and supervises OpenCode for you, lists your projects, and listens on localhost only
steps.zh: 替你启动并托管 OpenCode，列出项目，只监听本机

steps.en: Start a session and give it a finish line instead of a one-shot prompt
steps.zh: 开一个会话，给它一个终点，而不是一问一答

steps.en: After every turn it audits the result and keeps the agent working until done, blocked, or out of budget
steps.zh: 每轮结束后审计结果，让 agent 一直干到完成、卡住或超出预算

steps.en: Hand the same task to up to five models at once
steps.zh: 把同一个任务同时交给最多五个模型

steps.en: Gives each run its own session and optional worktree, so you pick the best or fuse the strongest parts
steps.zh: 每个 run 一条会话、可选独立 worktree，你挑最好的那个

steps.en: Review the change as ordered stops, or point at a live element to send its styles and errors
steps.zh: 按有序的 stop 读改动，或指着页面元素把样式和报错发给它

steps.en: Pair another device with a one-time QR code
steps.zh: 用一次性二维码把另一台设备配对进来

steps.en: Relays the session end-to-end encrypted, so you answer from anywhere without opening a port
steps.zh: 端到端加密地中转会话，你在任何地方都能接着答，不用开端口

value.en: You keep control of agent work from any device — sessions keep going while you are away, and review, git, and the PR sit beside the chat
value.zh: 你在任何设备上都能掌控 agent 的工作：你不在时它继续跑，评审、git 和 PR 就在对话旁边
